rule: Per station and lead band (hours after the last observation), the member with the best recent skill S = 0.25[R2 + e^(-|Bias|/sd) + e^(-MAE/sd) + e^(-RMSE/sd)] (mean over 10 days, weighted exp(-age/3 d)); it must lead the current pick by 0.01 for 2 updates running. P-ETSS until 7 days of verified runs exist and the member has 12 scores; Tidewatch, the baseline and the tide alone are never picked; stations whose archived observations were another gauge's (GS01, USAR, USBB, USCB, USNR, USSB, USSC) stay on P-ETSS.
